About Us

More than a restaurant — Sialkot's biggest family destination

G.A Family Restaurant is the city's highest-rated large family restaurant, loved for its generous luxury buffet, live BBQ and Turkish platters — and for everything around the table: green lawns, event spaces and GA Wonder Land, where children can visit the mini zoo, race go-karts and play while the family dines.

Six cuisines meet on one menu, from Afghan and Arabic favourites to Pakistani classics and continental pasta — so everyone at the table finds their dish.
